testcase.name: a workflow start needs an idempotency key and an object input()
a rejected mutation is 422 and may carry its onError follow-ups()
an empty body is a LIVE request with nothing in it()
query params are plain values within the limit and the page is range checked()
a body that is not an object is refused()
rate limited carries Retry-After from the details()
status codes follow the contract table()
mode must be LIVE or TEST exactly()
the generic error body has the ApiError shape()
the mapping of a query is the single mapping that names it()
fields the contract does not list are refused, whatever their name()
an unknown outcome is 409 and never retryable even if a caller claimed it was()
ok and would-run are 200 and a would-run says nothing was executed()
